geometry.damage: Tony damages only its visible stream envelope; Sean damages eligible targets in the visible rain-covered gameplay viewport.
geometry.reach: Ray extends from registered outlet to current viewport boundary in aimed direction
geometry.occlusion: Clip visible stream and damage against actual projectile-blocking solid geometry; scenery decoration does not block
geometry.thickness: Use full stream width for occlusion and hit tests; no damaging unseen strips past a wall
geometry.world_anchors: Pipe and outlet remain world-anchored through camera scroll; no camera-driven teleport
geometry.fade: Visible shrinking water and damaging envelope shrink together
geometry.scope: Existing stream envelope/occlusion/reach/thickness/fade fields below apply to Tony only. Sean uses sean.rain_targeting.

tony.name: Hydrojet Overdrive
tony.aim: Use existing valid regular weapon aiming and facing, including airborne restrictions; continuous stream through reversal
tony.movement: Normal jump allowed. Idle slides horizontally opposite aim by recoil speed times absolute horizontal aim component. Walking against horizontal recoil gives exactly half normal walking speed net. Pure vertical aiming produces no horizontal recoil. Ordinary terrain and pit collision remain active.
tony.audio: Start once, uninterrupted sustained loop through aim/facing changes, then shutdown
tony.activation: One fresh special-button press starts automatic sustained damage for the action. Neither special nor ordinary fire needs to remain held.

sean.name: Main Break
sean.activation: Requires supported ground and room for the Art-registered pipe assembly; rejected activation does not consume charge
sean.movement: Cinematic freezes gameplay. At handoff start rain clock0 and restore normal movement/jump/ordinary fire immediately. Pipe is already emerged; never root Sean or replay preparation based on rain elapsed. Pipe stays world anchored; rain follows current viewport.
sean.facing: Captured facing registers hero/tool/socket only. Pipe eruption is straight up; no tilt or horizontal sweep.
sean.water: Huge vertical geyser during final cinematic reveal, after cup clears outlet; no cinematic damage. At control return, rain covers current gameplay screen for7.5seconds. Individual drops are presentation only.
sean.art: Art supplies upright pipe/geyser and layered rain preserving silhouettes, HUD readability and selected costume. Reuse registered effort poses; no duplicated board/tool/pipe or unsupported outlet. Preserve existing sources.

spent_pipe.presentation: Only after rain ends, begin the currently approved inert pipe retirement/collapse treatment from its ACTUAL upright final pose. Previously reviewed horizontal-start collapse cannot be assumed compatible.
spent_pipe.gameplay: No collision, support, damage, water or continuing special audio. Never count as a platform or change navigation.
spent_pipe.interruption: Death/cancel clears active rain, active/spent props and all special audio under current attempt cleanup; no refund.
spent_pipe.lifetime: Clear at attempt teardown/reset; any retained/collapsing prop is harmless scenery and never extends rain damage.
spent_pipe.limit: At most two retained pipes per logical level, matching its two-use budget.
spent_pipe.visual_review: Keep ground contact and scenery occlusion correct; verify the spent prop does not obscure floor hazards, hero feet or active enemies.

rain_clock.clock_domain: Independent gameplay rain clock, starts0 AFTER cinematic finishes; never charge presentation time against rain duration.
rain_clock.expiry: Visual rain ends at handoff+7.5; no immediate tick, expiry bonus or fractional last tick. No damage during entire cinematic, pause or teardown.
rain_clock.hitches: Process each genuinely elapsed rain interval once; no presentation catch-up. Host simulation must substep camera/target state if processing several intervals.
rain_clock.pose_handoff: Clock0 means rain start, not old plant pose. Preserve fully emerged upright pipe and free hero control independently of legacy special elapsed.

rain_targeting.viewport: Current host gameplay viewport in world coordinates at each pulse, normally Rect2(camera_x,0,960,540); use restored gameplay camera, not cinematic zoom.
rain_targeting.eligibility: Living hostile entity currently admitted/damageable, with a positive-area intersection between an existing damageable region and viewport. Re-evaluate each pulse; newly admitted entrants may be hit on next pulse, offscreen targets cannot. Fully hidden/pre-entry/spawn-immune actors remain excluded.
include: Regular enemies including flyers and Cuddlebugs
Existing hostile objects with destructible HP, including Clogfather gas and reinforcement monsters
exclude: Indestructible projectiles, acid pools, floor webs or other hazards without a damageable HP API
rain_targeting.occlusion: Viewport-wide rain supersedes Sean line-of-sight/solid clipping; ordinary walls/platforms do not shield eligible on-screen targets. Do not alter Tony occlusion.
rain_targeting.dedup: One hit per logical target per activation/tick. One aggregate swarm HP pool, one boss despite multiple body regions; each independent destructible hazard its own stable ID.
rain_targeting.boss_gates: Preserve closed-shell, weak-point, phase and airborne-hero qualifications; no damage banked while ineligible.
rain_targeting.no_extra_effects: No self/environment damage, stun, slow, forced displacement or projectile clearing added.

fractional_damage.float_hp: Apply37.5 directly through float-capable target APIs.
fractional_damage.integer_api: Maintain remainder per activation and stable target identity. On an eligible accepted hit, total=37.5+remainder; deal floor(total), retain fractional remainder. First/second eligible hits37/38, then repeat; never truncate every tick to37.
fractional_damage.rejected_hits: Blocked/invulnerable/offscreen ticks neither accumulate nor consume remainder. Existing accepted remainder survives temporary ineligibility only within same activation; no skipped damage catch-up.
fractional_damage.identity: Do not share remainder between targets; boss identity may span forms only when same logical health pool. New target/respawn gets fresh remainder.
fractional_damage.cleanup: Clear on target death, effect expiry, cancel, level/reset/teardown; no carry into another activation. HP clamp/kill occurs through existing target API.
